verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say it was designed from the ground up for self-hosting. It runs on any OS with a Docker CLI or on Kubernetes via an official Helm chart, offers one-click marketplace installs, and supports migration between Cloud and self-hosted. Independent community reports praise the self-hosting guide and describe easy installs for home projects. Community skepticism about scaling docs and about the burden of running your own infrastructure does not contradict the capability.
